name: gitlab_public-mcp
description: GitLab.com (public projects, no token) (builder tools): list_items, get_item. Every tool maps to a d

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Public projects (oldest id first) whose name or path matches query; collection is ignored (projects only). Pages by cursor: pass next_cursor back.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: item_id is the numeric project id (list_items), or the URL-encoded path 'group%2Fproject' (GitLab rejects a raw slash).
